new_item_policy: Prefer related words/expressions. If recall is weak, reduce to 1 or 0 new items. Never fill time mechanically.
opening: 20–40 s: announce today's words/expressions, structure, pronunciation focus and concrete communicative goal.
per_item_cycle: give nuance/context/francophone trap only if useful (10–30 s)
re-expose later in same session if useful

blocking_logic.aide: ask what is blocking; hint → stronger hint → model → solution
blocking_logic.réponse: give solution immediately, then one reuse attempt
blocking_logic.arrête-toi: pause/free-mode exit and return to guided mode

repeated_error: At 3–4 recurrences, flag a firmer micro-remediation (~1 min) for the start of the next session; cap impact so it never hijacks the lesson.
conversation: guided → semi-guided → 1–3 min free conversation when appropriate; French rescue always available.
end: No new content. 30–60 s factual recap within final block; items + status + one useful pronunciation note + what will return.
